threshold_policy: distance/cum_gain/cum_loss/slope use fixed outdoor-hiking thresholds; no batch min-max normalization
note: 體力難度以固定門檻正規化，避免同一路線因批次資料不同而分數漂移

threshold_policy: use fixed feature mapping base_score/base_weight; no runtime LLM scoring
note: 技術難度描述通過技巧，不等同於基礎危害

threshold_policy: hazard uses max/presence logic because rare high-consequence hazards should not be diluted by route length
note: 基礎危害是正常天候下的固有危害；天候放大另由 weather_impact_score 處理

threshold_policy: junction density and wrong-turn recovery access use fixed thresholds; trail visibility, guidepost/marker deficit and route continuity use mapping table or graph-derived scores; road/service/track/unclassified access is interpreted as wrong-turn recovery context, not general support distance
note: v1.1 更新；迷航風險同時包含路線選擇複雜度、導航支援不足與錯路後可恢復性。若同一 road access feature 同時用於支援不易，需以 double_count_guard 限制權重或分流語意。

threshold_policy: road distance, exit gap and long route without exit increase evacuation difficulty; visitor center, police station, ranger/management station, shelter, hut, water and rest facilities decrease facility deficit; emergency landing site, helipad and large open area decrease rescue operation difficulty; single bridge/corridor dependence increases bottleneck score
note: v1.2 更新；支援不易改為四子分數加權：撤退與道路接近困難、支援與避難設施缺乏、救援作業困難、關鍵通行節點瓶頸。可用設施為 decrease feature，僅降低支援不易，不降低路線本身基礎危害。

threshold_policy: weather impact is route sensitivity to bad weather, not actual weather forecast
note: 此軸不使用當日天氣預報；只描述天氣惡化時路線風險被放大的程度
